header.name: Five Nights at Rustgrin's (Behavior)
header.description: Five nights, six animatronics and one Ringmaster who knows your name. An original FNAF-style night-guard horror game: security cameras, doors, vents, a show tape that must keep playing, and a Final Act. No experiments needed. Requires the matching resource pack.

modules.description: Night simulation, cameras, map builder, UI
